root: ^There seem to be troubles in the area still but they seem minor compared to what was possessing them. It has come to our attention that vegetation and, forests and crops are dying quicker and the natives are upset. The northern lands have a cooler climate than ours so we are not worried.
^The people might resist but our Script must be passed on to save them. Knowledge is most important to aid our sisters and brothers on this earth.
^All praise the Holy! We greet you brother, take our invitation with a warm embrace.
^the Servants of the Blessed in the year of Lamb
